# Figures

```{r figure-setup, eval=FALSE}
method_order <- c(
  "Backward p-value",
  "AIC",
  "BIC",
  "LASSO lambda.min",
  "LASSO lambda.1se",
  "Elastic Net lambda.min",
  "Elastic Net lambda.1se"
)

method_short <- c(
  "Backward",
  "AIC",
  "BIC",
  "LASSO min",
  "LASSO 1se",
  "EN min",
  "EN 1se"
)

method_colors <- c(
  "Backward" = "#0072B2",
  "AIC" = "#E69F00",
  "BIC" = "#009E73",
  "LASSO min" = "#D55E00",
  "LASSO 1se" = "#56B4E9",
  "EN min" = "#CC79A7",
  "EN 1se" = "#999999"
)

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
```

## Figure 1: TPR/FPR tradeoff

```{r figure1-tradeoff, eval=FALSE}
fig1_data <- method_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(method, levels = method_order, labels = method_short),
    n = factor(n),
    rho = factor(rho)
  )

fig1 <- ggplot(
  fig1_data,
  aes(x = mean_FPR, y = mean_TPR, color = Method, shape = rho)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_TPR - 1.96 * mcse_TPR,
      ymax = mean_TPR + 1.96 * mcse_TPR
    ),
    width = 0,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = mean_FPR - 1.96 * mcse_FPR,
      xmax = mean_FPR + 1.96 * mcse_FPR
    ),
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ n, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, NA), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1. Trade-off Between True Positive Rate and False Positive Rate",
    subtitle = "Upper-left region indicates better selection performance",
    x = "Mean False Positive Rate",
    y = "Mean True Positive Rate",
    shape = expression(rho)
  ) +
  plot_theme

fig1

ggsave(file.path(results_fig, "Figure1_TPR_FPR_Tradeoff.png"), fig1,
       width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

## Figure 2: Variable-level power

```{r figure2-variable-power, eval=FALSE}
fig2_data <- variable_summary %>%
  filter(beta_true != 0) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(method, levels = method_order, labels = method_short),
    n = factor(n),
    rho = factor(rho),
    variable_label = paste0(variable, "\nβ=", round(beta_true, 3)),
    variable_label = factor(variable_label, levels = unique(variable_label[order(beta_true)]))
  )

fig2 <- ggplot(
  fig2_data,
  aes(x = variable_label, y = selection_probability, color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(rho ~ n, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Variable-Level Power for Truly Associated Predictors",
    subtitle = "Selection probability shown separately for X1 through X5",
    x = "True Predictor",
    y = "Selection Probability"
  ) +
  plot_theme

fig2

ggsave(file.path(results_fig, "Figure2_Variable_Level_Power.png"), fig2,
       width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Figure 3: Variable-level bias

```{r figure3-variable-bias, eval=FALSE}
fig3 <- ggplot(
  fig2_data,
  aes(x = variable_label, y = mean_bias_uncond, color = Method, group = Method)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_grid(rho ~ n, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3. Variable-Level Unconditional Bias for Truly Associated Predictors",
    subtitle = "Negative values indicate downward bias from non-selection or shrinkage",
    x = "True Predictor",
    y = "Mean Unconditional Bias"
  ) +
  plot_theme

fig3

ggsave(file.path(results_fig, "Figure3_Variable_Level_Bias.png"), fig3,
       width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Figure 4: Coverage heatmap

```{r figure4-coverage, eval=FALSE}
fig4_data <- inference_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(method, levels = method_order, labels = method_short),
    n = factor(n),
    rho = factor(rho)
  )

fig4 <- ggplot(
  fig4_data,
  aes(x = Method, y = rho, fill = mean_coverage_true_vars)
) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_coverage_true_vars)), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ n, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#D55E00",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#0072B2",
    midpoint = 0.95,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Coverage"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 4. Empirical 95% CI Coverage for Truly Associated Predictors",
    subtitle = "Values closer to 0.95 indicate better nominal coverage",
    x = "Method",
    y = expression(rho)
  ) +
  plot_theme

fig4

ggsave(file.path(results_fig, "Figure4_Coverage_Heatmap.png"), fig4,
       width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```
